1560. Wildcard Pattern Matching with Z Algorithm

90

Hard

Problem Statement:
Given a text string and a pattern string, implement a function to determine if the pattern matches the entire text. The pattern may contain the wildcard characters:
- '?' which matches any single character.
- '*' which matches any sequence of characters (including the empty sequence).

You are required to use the Z Algorithm as part of your solution.
input_spec: The first line contains the text string. The second line contains the pattern string.
output_spec: Print "YES" if the pattern matches the entire text, otherwise print "NO".
constraints: 1 ≤ length of text ≤ 10^5 1 ≤ length of pattern ≤ 10^5 Both text and pattern consist of lowercase English letters, '?', and '*'.
